status: predeclared before actual ERA5 forecast inference
scope: Single prespecified retrospective weather case, suitable for a forecast-and-verification lesson only; not an operational weather benchmark
checkpoint: NVIDIA fourcastnet1 c67a63995f6c8e0e557eb3d791f32f437e9b02d5, official26-channel order and normalization
input_rule: Only initial ERA5 state; no future truth, no feeding correct state back into forecast
truth: Later ERA5 reanalysis, not direct observations
source_preprocessing: Exact model-grid ordering; documented NVIDIA IFS mixed-phase RH from ERA5 q/T/p, including the official derived-RH bounds0..100percent. No other input field clipping, forecast clipping or amplitude rescaling.
metrics: Cos(latitude)-weighted physical-unit errors; no absolute-pressure relative-percent accuracy
runtime: Report measured local GPU time and peak memory. L4 remains unmeasured; do not substitute local timings.
failure_policy: Report any failed criterion. Do not pick another date, shorten horizon or change thresholds to relabel this run as passed. Corrections require identified preprocessing or implementation bugs and explicit records.
integration: Published as the weather forecasting Lab 4 after local candidate validation; the previous PINN lab is preserved under ETC/reference_labs. L4 runtime must be measured separately.
